narrative:
Inventory optimization completed for material PL2__MDD08FE8. 

DEMAND PROFILE: Demand exhibits an erratic pattern with CV=0.58, suggesting high variability. 
A statistically significant upward trend was detected (p<0.001), with demand increasing by approximately 
30.4 units per period. The distribution is best modeled as Negative Binomial. Mean daily demand 
is 3088 units with considerable volatility (std=1786).

LEAD TIME PROFILE: Lead time is highly volatile (CV=0.63), averaging 2.06 days with 
std=1.30 days. This volatility is the dominant contributor to safety stock requirements, 
accounting for 70.9% of total variance.

RECOMMENDED POLICY: Safety stock of 7830 units is required to achieve 95% 
service level. EOQ analysis suggests optimal order quantity of 26057 units, resulting in 
approximately 30 orders per year. Reorder point is 14207 units.

COST IMPACT: The optimized policy reduces total annual costs from $40394.46 to 
$3853.71, achieving savings of $36540.75 (90.5%). 
This is primarily driven by balancing ordering frequency against holding costs.

SAFETY LEAD TIME: Recommended safety lead time is 2.54 days, which is 
0.96 days lower than the current SAP 
setting of 3.5 days. Action: decrease.

research_insights.selected_model: Combined EOQ with Safety Stock (Negative Binomial demand, volatile lead time)
research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic demand pattern (CV=0.58) with significant trend and volatile lead time (CV=0.63) requires robust buffer management. Negative Binomial distribution accommodates overdispersion.
research_insights.boundary_risk: High lead time volatility and demand trend create elevated stockout risk. Continuous monitoring recommended.
